title: predication-cell
description: The object of the predication category - an assertion-position, the ordered oriented triple (s, p, o) from subject through predicate to object. The location at which a valuation later records evidence.

subject.description: first coordinate s - the subject entity

predicate.description: second coordinate p - a typed predicate, not a label

object.description: third coordinate o - the object entity

oriented.description: (s,p,o) != (o,p,s): subject and object positions are not interchangeable
